Edit process unit

A TWO-MINUTE INTRODUCTION

From flowsheet to balanced data.

1

Place your units

Drag a process unit from the toolbox. Add red inflow and outflow triangles to mark your model boundaries.

2

Connect the material paths

Drag a unit's right-hand port to the next unit's left-hand port. Or choose Connect, click the source, then click the destination.

3

Add meters and batch readings

Right-click a line, enter its material properties, and enable a meter. Open Measurements to enter its reading and uncertainty.

4

Run and review

Run reconciliation. Compare measured and reconciled masses, review adjustments, and check which unmetered streams can be inferred.

What this model assumes

No accumulation inside process units. Include all inflows, products, waste and vent paths. A closed balance estimates consistency; it does not prove every meter is correct.

Double-click a unit to rename it. Double-click a line to edit it. Delete removes the selection. Scroll to zoom. Ctrl+Z undoes edits. Export a JSON file to move a model to another browser.

Runs in your browser. No measurements are sent to a server.
